data.name: Dimitra
data.gender_notes: Dimitra is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Dimitra was the goddess of the harvest, fertility, and agriculture. In Christian tradition, she is also known as Saint Demetra, the patron saint of childbirth and child care. The name Dimitra comes from the Greek word ‘demos’ which means ‘people’ and ‘metra’ meaning ‘measure’, symbolizing the balance and harmony between people and their environment.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of the goddess Demeter, who represents nurturing, growth, and transformation.
data.etymology: Dimitra belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devoted to God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dimitra total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

Today, Dimitra is a popular given name in many Christian cultures, symbolizing the glory and greatness of the people of God.
